title: CompiledAgentContext
description: The context compiled for the calling user at one hook event, returned by `POST /v1/agentHarness/compile`.

appliedHarness.description: A published harness the context was compiled from.

displayName.description: Human-readable name to show for the harness. A persona harness is named by its persona's id so a persona rename does not break it; this is the persona's display name, or its name when it has none.

version.description: Published version the context was compiled from.

appliedHarnesses.description: The harnesses that applied to the caller.

persona.description: The harness of the caller's persona. Absent when that persona has no enabled, published harness.

segment.description: One part of the compiled text and its size.

kind.description: What the part holds, for example Instructions, Glossary, Metrics, Assets or Memories.

decisionAction.description: What the agent host does with the tool call.

decision.description: Outcome of the guardrails evaluated for a tool call.

action.description: The strictest action any matching guardrail asks for.

reasons.description: One reason per guardrail that matched.

harness.description: The harnesses the context was compiled from.

text.description: The context to inject at the event.

tokens.description: Estimated tokens in `text`. Equal to the sum of the segments.

segments.description: The parts `text` is made of, in order.

decision.description: Guardrail decision for the tool call. Present only for PreToolUse.
